chunks: The day the enemies of God will be gathered at the Fire and the records of their deeds will be distributed,
ai.seo_question: What happens to the enemies of God on the Day of Judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the passive verb 'yuz'oon' (they are distributed) emphasizes the precision of divine justice, where the enemies of Allah are gathered not merely as a crowd but as individuals whose specific deeds are weighed and handed over. This gathering marks the transition from the general assembly of humanity to the specific reckoning of the disbelievers, highlighting the culmination of their enmity against the divine order. The imagery serves as a stark contrast to the honor bestowed upon the faithful, underscoring the ultimate fate of those who opposed God's prophets and imams.
